rule: written before round1_v21.py was run on the recorded screen with prior_v21.json; each carries what falsifies it; a prediction that fails is published as failed, not edited

readings.metric: First-screen advance count (need 20 or more and viability 9 or more, status empty) on the recorded 15,797-name screen after the v2.1 tables, relabels and boosts
readings.expected_after: 3,350 to 3,500. Computed floor 3,267: 136 names cross on the table changes alone (Yahoo Information Technology Services 64, Yahoo Telecom Services 62, Yahoo Specialty Business Services 7, Computer Communications Equipment via its Yahoo entry 3) and 0 are cut, from a re-run of the recorded screen with the real Yahoo-base-plus-boost mechanism. Description routes add 85 to 230 from bounded pools (software base 216, former software:infrastructure 49, conglomerate 81, Computer Hardware 21, Trucking 17, materials with profiles 188, about 330 newly fetched exchange-coded names) at proxy hit rates measured on the 2,493 stage 2 descriptions: sensing 4 percent of software descriptions, physical information substrate 5 percent, tools mechanism tokens 8 percent, circulation nouns 4 percent of non-health descriptions
readings.falsified_if: Above 3,650 (a description route is a floodgate: identify it from the per-family lines below and withdraw that regex) or below 3,290 (the description routes attached fewer than 23 names and the boost table is inert as written)
readings.reading: below the 3,350 to 3,500 range at 3347; the computed floor 3,267 held (154 table admissions against 136 registered) and the description route has admitted 62 with 384 of the owed descriptions on file
readings.status: provisional: the description route is still converging (1112 descriptions owed)

readings.metric: Yahoo Telecom Services family: names newly admitted and their stage 2 outcome
readings.expected_after: 62 newly admitted; stage 2 A or B rate 5 to 25 percent under the admissibility rule, with cut reasons naming a missing host number (persons connected per dollar, price per connection series) rather than a label
readings.falsified_if: Stage 2 rate below 3 percent (the parity prior admits only names a stock-attached reading rejects; revert the entry to 18 at the next registration) or above 40 percent (the reader treats the relabel as a pass; re-run a blind seeded sample of 12)
readings.reading: FAILED as registered: the A or B rate is far above 25 percent. The judges verdict B on territory-bound carriers where the recorded Aug 2026 round gave C (no scalable product layer); the verdict scale drifted between rounds, which the blind reliability batch (P12) must price

readings.metric: Yahoo Information Technology Services hybrids: names newly admitted and their stage 2 outcome
readings.expected_after: 64 newly admitted; pooled stage 2 A or B rate 10 to 30 percent
readings.falsified_if: Below 5 percent (the parity fix admits identical evidence that the stage 2 read rejects, so the software bases were too generous) or above 50 percent
readings.reading: the pooled A or B rate is above the registered 13 to 37 percent band, with zero A: every B names a diluted multi-vertical consultancy. On the recorded scale most of these are C; same drift as P02

readings.status: readable in part: 384 of the owed descriptions are on file after the first weekly fetch; the count grows as fetch_profiles.py converges

readings.expected_after: 1,310 (exactly the 40 Information Technology Services software:health names the parity fix carries, computed), share 37 to 39.5 percent; no exchange or Yahoo health prior moves

readings.metric: Stage 2 vocabulary and pass rate on the relabelled tools and information classes
readings.expected_after: 0 cuts on a Layer 0 class without the named missing B item; tools plus information pass rate 30 to 45 percent
readings.falsified_if: Pass rate above 55 percent (the relabel leaks names through judgment rather than evidence), or more than 2 percent of cuts on those classes lack the named item (the admissibility rule is not being applied)
readings.reading: 41 of 77 C reasons name the missing B item or a survivability fact across both Round 2 rounds. The first round (154 table admissions) failed at 8 of 33 because its prompt did not carry the admissibility vocabulary; the description-route round carried it and named the item in 33 of 44. Recorded as failed for the first round and passing for the second
readings.status: final on this round; pipeline defect recorded

readings.metric: Blind re-score of the ranked 53 under the v2.1 clauses: health control, transport and tech clusters, loop-sign order, rank stability
readings.expected_after: health mean within 2 points (73.8 to 77.8); rail E unchanged and transport E mean 3.4 to 4.2; every corridor owner's F_clock stays 3 and transport F_clock mean 3.4 to 3.8; tech C1 mean 5.2 to 6.4 with TSM and TOELY staying in 2 to 5 (compute per person has no ceiling) and at least 3 amplifying labels remaining; tech A 14.0 to 15.4 (a conduct-test result on YMM may move its deduction from 3 to 1); health names at B 21 or above fall to 12 to 17 as efficacy-only trials become class 3 unless computed, non-health 5 to 8; the damping above neutral above amplifying order holds; Spearman between v2.0 and v2.1 totals 0.88 to 0.98
readings.falsified_if: Health mean moves more than 3 points (the clauses re-price medicine); any rail E rises above 3 (the node test rewards size); any corridor owner's F_clock moves (the asset basis was not respected); tech C1 mean above 7.5 or no amplifying label left (the bounded band is a relabel); non-health B 21 or above exceeds 10 (the class table lowered the standard); the loop-sign order breaks; Spearman below 0.80 (a new instrument, to be registered as v3 with a fresh vintage)
readings.status: pending: readable once data/rigor/v21_cards_rescore.json is assembled (assemble_v21.py)

readings.metric: Blind second-scorer agreement on a new pre-registered 8-name batch (at least 3 information or tools class names and 2 transport names) scored from the v2.1 text alone
readings.expected_after: A at most 2.5, B 2.7, C 1.8, D 1.2, E 1.6, F 1.0; total at most 7; gate 8 of 8; every card carries the recorded items (host flow with Layer 0 id, evidence class, rebound outcome, ceiling, penetration, largest node, three moat results, clock basis)
readings.falsified_if: Any clause-affected measure above twice its current deviation (A 4.0, B 4.4, C 2.6, E 2.2, F 1.0), total above 9, gate agreement below 8 of 8, or more than 1 of 8 cards lacking a recorded item; the failing clause reverts to its v2.0 text pending rewrite
readings.status: pending: awaits the next blind reliability batch scored from the v2.1 text

readings.metric: Universe forward-return information coefficient of v2.1 first-screen scores against the frozen v2.0 endpoint, same names and window (about 9,982 priced names, horizon 2027-08-28)
readings.expected_after: IC(v2.1) at or above IC(v2.0) minus 0.005; the re-priced subset (the 136 computed admissions plus the description-route admissions) carries an advanced-minus-cut spread with the same sign as the universe spread
readings.falsified_if: IC(v2.1) below IC(v2.0) by more than 0.01, or the re-priced subset's spread has the opposite sign to the universe spread; the prior changes revert at the next registration with the reversal published
